name: ubuntu-security
description: Agent skills for host security on Ubuntu desktops and servers: ufw firewall setup, status, scoped allows, rule removal and block diagnosis; ClamAV / rkhunter / chkrootkit / Lynis / AIDE install, definition updates, scans and scheduling; read-only security audits, security-update and spyware/telemetry checks; SSH keys, SSH server config and fail2ban; YubiKey/FIDO2 and fingerprint authentication; TLS certificate checks.
